name: Rajesh Sharma
title: Senior Software Engineer
summary: Senior Software Engineer at Capgemini with deep experience in front-end architecture and full-stack delivery. I build React and Next.js applications on Node, Express and Azure, with a strong focus on cross-browser compatibility, accessibility and performance tuning.
about: I have spent my career on the front end of the web — from Flash and hand-sliced layouts in 2007 to React, TypeScript and Next.js today. Along the way I moved from building pages to leading the teams that build them, as UI Lead at Accenture and Technical Manager at Capgemini, before relocating to Sweden.

My day-to-day sits across the whole delivery lifecycle: requirements analysis, system design, coding, testing, debugging, documentation and release. I care about design systems and mockup fidelity as much as bundle size, and I am equally comfortable in Photoshop and Adobe XD as in a Terraform module.

I have delivered on enterprise platforms including Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Demandware), Adobe Experience Manager, Magento and WordPress. Currently I am focused on cloud (Azure and GCP), DevOps practice, and GenAI integration.
